There's no reason to force a new trade when the setups aren't there.
layman_action: Hold your current positions and let them run toward their targets. UNI at $5.21 is approaching its $5.65 exit target — consider tightening your mental stop. No new entries today.
expert_reasoning: The candidate pool is exceptionally weak this cycle. MON is down 16.5% weekly and 45.8% from ATH with zero technical indicator data — a potential value trap without confirmation. PONS is up 394% in 7 days and only 11.9% from ATH — chasing here is reckless. PUMP is down 50% from ATH with continued selling pressure. The remaining candidates are stablecoins. BTC dominance at 59.2% continues to suppress alt performance, and the fear/greed index is deteriorating (69→62). With both current positions in green and progressing toward targets, the highest-EV decision is to hold and wait for a better setup, particularly since our signal credibility data warns that Blockworks-driven setups have a 0% win rate and Fear_Greed signals are only 56% reliable.
